candidates.title: Sri Lanka’s former President Mahinda Rajapaksa admitted to hospital for urgent medical care
candidates.excerpt: Mr. Rajapaksa's hospitalisation comes amid legal proceedings involving his family, with his wife Shiranthi and elder son Namal facing separate investigations over alleged financial irregularities

candidates.title: Rahul says INDIA bloc to file petition in SC, urges citizens to join fight over SIR
candidates.excerpt: Gandhi announced that Opposition leaders would march towards the Apex court to initiate the legal process and appealed to citizens to join their campaign in support of the Constitution and democracy.

candidates.title: Jantar Mantar de-notified as ‘designated’ protest site; three new venues allocated
candidates.excerpt: Jantar Mantar has been de-notified as the "designated" protesting site, Delhi Police said on Monday.

candidates.title: CJP Gives Delhi Police 24-Hour Deadline for Jantar Mantar Protest Date
candidates.excerpt: CJP activist Saurav Das said the party was willing to let the police decide the date and time for the protest

candidates.title: Telangana government to review RTC-Metro common pass fares after complaints
candidates.excerpt: The Telangana government will review RTC-Metro common pass fares following complaints from commuters. The daily pass costs Rs. 400, while the monthly pass is priced at Rs. 8,500. Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar said a meeting with officials would be held soon.

candidates.title: No Essential Medicines, Key Services Not Working at OGH, Say Protesting Doctors
candidates.excerpt: The doctors have withdrawn general services, elective outpatient services and elective operation theatre services as part of their protest, demanding the release of pending funds to ensure patient care.

candidates.title: Govt to Review RTC-Metro Common Pass Charges: Ponnam
candidates.excerpt: The Minister said that the public's views and actual conditions are being reviewed in the wake of continuous complaints from the public that the common pass charges are high
